title: Nissan UD PK17 FUPS compliant hi-tensile polished Aluminium Bullbar #3
description: UD PK17 hi-tensile FUPS aluminium Bullbar. Heavy duty contoured channel to suit driving lights plus fog lights. Main cross tube is one piece 76mm tube through drilled uprights and recessed into the outer uprights with bent upper pipe. Tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate. Driving light mounts can be fitted to customer requirements.
